Retail Construction Services — Dallas–Fort Worth

Your storefront is more than square footage — it’s the customer experience, the brand promise, and the revenue engine. At Rooster & Co., we build retail spaces that perform. Serving the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, we combine local market knowledge, disciplined project management, and hands-on craftsmanship to deliver attractive, safe, and code-compliant retail environments on schedule and on budget.

What we do for retail clients
- Tenant improvements & store buildouts — from shell to showroom-ready, including fixtures, flooring, millwork, storefronts and merchandising platforms.
- Remodels & refreshes — phased renovations and cosmetic upgrades that minimize downtime during store hours.
- Ground-up retail construction — free‑standing shops, strip-center pads, and in-line retail units built to brand and local requirements.
- Adaptive reuse & conversions — convert offices, warehouses, or vacant spaces into modern retail destinations.
- MEP, lighting & systems integration — HVAC, plumbing, electrical and lighting designed for comfort, energy efficiency and merchandising needs.
- Signage & storefronts — secure, code-compliant exterior systems that maximize curb appeal.
- Accessibility & code compliance — ADA, fire, life-safety and local Dallas–Fort Worth permitting handled from design through inspection.
- Fast-track construction & phased scheduling — meet aggressive openings or holiday season deadlines with careful staging and coordination.
- Value engineering & cost control — practical alternatives that protect aesthetics and performance while optimizing budget.
- Ongoing maintenance & remodel programs — keep your stores safe, attractive and up to date across multiple locations.

Why retailers in Dallas–Fort Worth choose Rooster & Co.
- Local expertise: We know DFW permitting, building codes, and the neighborhoods that drive foot traffic — from downtown Dallas corridors to growing suburban retail hubs.
- Single-source accountability: One point of contact for design coordination, subcontractor management, scheduling and quality control.
- Minimized downtime: We plan work around store hours and merchandising cycles to protect sales and customer experience.
- Trusted trade partners: Longstanding relationships with vetted subcontractors and suppliers keep projects on track and materials available.
- Safety-first culture: Proactive safety programs protect your customers, staff and assets throughout construction.
- Transparent communication: Regular updates, clear schedules and open cost reporting so you always know status and risks.
- Built for your brand: Whether a national chain or local boutique, we deliver finishes and functionality that match your identity and operational needs.

Typical project types we excel at
- Quick-turn remodels for seasonal or promotional launches
- Multi-location rollouts and prototype implementations
- Mall and lifestyle center tenant finishes
- Restaurant and café buildouts
- Flagship stores and experiential retail spaces
- Convenience stores and service-oriented retail

Get started
Rooster & Co. brings Dallas–Fort Worth retail projects to life with predictable delivery, strong local relationships and an owner-focused approach. Contact us today to discuss your next store build, remodel or rollout — we’ll assess your goals and outline a pragmatic plan to open on time and within budget.
